CameraStress: Captured pose; yaw +/-8 degrees; camera local-right +/-12 world units; local-forward +12 world units (6 poses).
Method: Whole-patch and 8-/16-original-cell regional interior power-of-two coarsening. Original outer boundary heights/normals and skirt triangle count retained. Regional candidates retain all original vertices along region boundaries, so neighboring choices share exact edge geometry. Boundary cells use triangle fans through existing grid vertices. Baseline and candidate vertices/edge-midpoints/centroids are probed. Errors are ADDITIONAL differences from restored ORIGINAL regular meshes, not from the authoritative field or refined CSV meshes. Normal differences compare interpolated existing vertex normals; 5 degrees is an experimental guard, not a visibility threshold. The shape-normal-shore policy also keeps regions whose original height range crosses the saved water plane unchanged. No occlusion, silhouettes, material colors, complete water rendering, shadows, collisions, foliage, rendered images or frame times are validated. Timings are managed offline-harness durations and cannot predict Unity Burst, GPU cost, FPS or 1% lows. Sampled maxima are not formal error bounds.
